data.content: {"stage":"plan_review","round":1,"verdict":"fail","blocking_count":4,"warning_count":3,"findings":[{"check_id":"CRIT-MISSING","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-sort-report-tasks","requirement_ids":["R-d482bfea"],"message":"The PRD requires sorting by Creation Date, Due Date, Status, Priority or Title. AC6 and AC7 require the report API to sort by title, but the only backend task, BE-report-api-sort-parameter, accepts creation_date, due_date, status and priority and rejects other values. The API cannot meet AC6 or AC7 as planned, and the frontend title sort has no backend support.","suggested_fix":"Change BE-report-api-sort-parameter to accept title as well, and describe it as five sort fields."},{"check_id":"CRIT-MISREPRESENTED","severity":"blocking","item_key":"BE-status-change-error-handling","requirement_ids":["R-2304218f"],"message":"The task says an invalid input error is returned when the status is 'not Open or Completed'. The story (AC5) and BE-status-change-endpoint say any status other than Completed is rejected. The task allows Open and rejects In Progress, which contradicts them and the 'Mark as Completed' requirement. This is also duplicated error handling.","suggested_fix":"Say any value other than Completed is rejected, or merge the error handling into BE-status-change-endpoint."},{"check_id":"CRIT-MISSING","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-update-task","requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df"],"message":"The PRD says to update an existing task, and the data model includes the Last Updated Date. No AC or task says the backend refreshes Last Updated Date on update. The story also limits editing to title and Due Date, although the form is meant to edit the task in general (description, priority, status).","suggested_fix":"Add an AC and a BE-task-update-endpoint note that Last Updated Date is set on update. Let the story cover editing all editable fields."},{"check_id":"CRIT-MISSING","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-change-task-status","requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7"],"message":"R-9dc414dc/R-d57336f7 require a success or error message after create, update and delete actions. A status change is an update. AC1 has no success message, and the Last Updated Date is not updated on status change. FE-status-toggle-control shows only an error message on failure.","suggested_fix":"Add an AC and FE task behavior for a success message after a confirmed status change. Also set Last Updated Date on the change."},{"check_id":"CRIT-OVERLAP","severity":"warning","item_key":"BE-status-change-error-handling","requirement_ids":[],"message":"Duplicates the not-found and invalid-status handling already described in BE-status-change-endpoint (rejects other status values with invalid input error).","suggested_fix":"Narrow it to the not-found and internal/database errors only, or merge it into BE-status-change-endpoint."},{"check_id":"CRIT-UNTESTABLE-AC","severity":"warning","item_key":"US-sort-report-tasks","requirement_ids":["R-d482bfea"],"message":"AC2, AC3 and AC4 say rows are 'reordered by the field' without a direction or an order for Status and Priority, so the expected order cannot be verified. AC1 and AC5 leave the direction open ('as defined by the sort control').","suggested_fix":"State the expected order, for example Due Date ascending and Priority Low, Medium, High. Raise the order of Status values as an open question if the PRD does not define it."},{"check_id":"CRIT-MISSING","severity":"warning","item_key":"US-create-task","requirement_ids":["R-03df7815"],"message":"The edge case treats Due Date as optional, which the PRD does not state. AC5 and AC6 are fine, but no AC covers a missing Title with the mandatory-field error handling on the API. AC2 covers the empty title only at form level.","suggested_fix":"Keep the Due Date question open and add an AC that the create API rejects a request with no Title."}]}
